Example pricing

Example costs $49 per seat per month, billed annually. A 14-day trial needs no card. Teams of more than 50 seats move to annual invoicing at $41 per seat.

What is included

Every plan includes single sign-on, the full REST API, unlimited projects and 30 days of audit history. Support answers within four business hours.

How it compares

Competitor A charges $60 per seat and meters API calls. Competitor B charges $35 but bills SSO separately at $12 per seat.

Annual versus monthly

Annual billing saves 16 percent. Monthly billing is $58 per seat and can be cancelled at any time.

Volume pricing

Above 250 seats the price falls to $34 per seat and includes a named onboarding engineer.
